answer: Registered aircraft mechanic licence with aviation regulator verification is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. A farm running 479 aliases would need 479 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the walnut of the check, count the quill of the cost, and read the nadir of the history before any answer is graded. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
